api.update.how.casaos: In CasaOS, open Sunroom's menu and choose Update.
api.update.how.companion: It installs itself tonight, or tap Update Now.
api.update.how.companion_waits: It installs itself overnight, a day after it comes out.
api.update.how.computer: The screen that runs it installs updates overnight, or at once with Settings, then This Screen, then Update Now.
api.update.how.docker: In Sunroom's folder on the server, run docker compose pull, then docker compose up -d.
api.update.how.ha: Update it in Home Assistant, under Settings, then Add-ons.
api.update.how.other: Pull the newest scopexl/sunroom image in the app you installed it with, then start it again.
api.update.how.pi: This screen installs it tonight, or tap Update Sunroom under This Screen.
api.update.how.portainer: In Portainer, open the stack and choose Re-pull image and redeploy.
api.update.how.synology: In Container Manager, download the newest sunroom image, then reset the container.
api.update.how.unraid: On the Docker tab in Unraid, choose Check for Updates, then update Sunroom.
